defs.vwp: close / VWAP20 - 1; VWAP20 = sum(typical x volume) / sum(volume) over 20 sessions, typical = (H+L+C)/3
defs.pc: 2-yr percentile: mid-rank % of today's xATR within the name's own daily xATR values over the last 504 sessions (null under 250 sessions)
defs.lo: lowest daily xATR in the 2-yr window
defs.hi: highest daily xATR in the 2-yr window

sources.pctl2y: 2-yr stretch history: Massive grouped daily bars, 2024-09-25 to 2026-09-29 (504 sessions, EMA/ATR seeded from 2024-07-01)
